title: 第7章 不会说话就闭嘴第8章 本世子杀他们是为民除害
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
唰唰唰！
随着楚风那句“就是明抢”
的话音落下，整个斗兽场死一般的寂静。
所有人的目光都汇聚在楚风身上，眼神里写满了惊骇。
这位镇北世子是疯了么？
当着这么多人的面，公然抢夺沈国公府少爷花一百万两银子买下的战奴，这已经不是嚣张了，这是在**裸地践踏沈国公府的脸面！
“你……”
沈玉风那张原本还挂着微笑的俊脸，此刻瞬间阴沉如墨，他指着楚风，怒斥道：“楚风，你别太放肆了！
你真以为如今的镇北王府还是当年那个镇北王府？”
“如今的镇北王府，就靠你爷爷那个老不死的硬撑着，等他哪天咽了气，我看到时候谁还给你撑腰！”
话音尖锐刺耳，充满了怨毒。
啪！
一道清脆的耳光声毫无征兆地炸响！
楚风不知何时已踏前一步，一巴掌结结实实地抽在沈玉风的脸上。
巨大的力道直接将沈玉风整个人扇得原地转了半圈，而后狼狈地摔倒在地，半张脸以肉眼可见的速度红肿起来，一个清晰的五指印烙在其上。
“不会说话就闭嘴！”
楚风吐了口唾沫，冷冷地哼道。
“你……你敢打我？”
沈玉风捂着火辣辣的脸颊，脑子一片空白。
他，堂堂沈国公府的小少爷，六品武者，京城年轻一代的翘楚，竟然被一个公认的废物给当众掌掴了？

极致的屈辱感瞬间冲垮了他的理智！
“都愣着干什么！
给我上！
我要他死！
我要他生不如死！”
沈玉风面目狰狞地对着他那群随从咆哮。
那群随从如梦初醒，当即怒吼着朝楚风猛冲而来，身上气劲勃发，声势骇人。
然而，他们甚至没能靠近楚风三步之内。
一道黑色的鬼影在众人眼前一闪而过。
噗！
噗！
噗！
伴随着快到极致的寒光掠过，带起一连串沉闷的入肉声。
噗噗噗……
content_en:
Swish, swish, swish!
As Chu Feng said, "It's just a clear grab."
After the words fell, the entire Colosseum fell into deathly silence.
Everyone's eyes were focused on Chu Feng, their eyes filled with horror.
Is this Zhenbei Crown Prince crazy?
In front of so many people, openly robbing the war slaves that Young Master Shen Guogong's Mansion bought for one million taels of silver is no longer arrogant, this is nakedly trampling on the face of Shen Guogong's Mansion!
"You..."
Shen Yufeng's handsome face, which was originally smiling, turned gloomy at this moment. He pointed at Chu Feng and angrily shouted: "Chu Feng, don't be too presumptuous!
Do you really think that the Zhenbei Palace of today is still the Zhenbei Palace of the past? "
"Today's Zhenbei Prince's Mansion is only supported by your old immortal grandfather. When he dies one day, who will support you when I see him?"
The words were sharp and harsh, full of spite.
Snap!
A crisp slap sounded without warning!
Chu Feng didn't know when he had taken a step forward and slapped Shen Yufeng firmly on the face.
The huge force directly slapped Shen Yufeng around half a circle, and then he fell to the ground in embarrassment. Half of his face became red and swollen at a speed visible to the naked eye, and a clear five-finger mark was imprinted on it.
"Shut up if you can't speak!"
Chu Feng spat and hummed coldly.
"You...you dare to hit me?"
Shen Yufeng covered his burning cheeks, his mind went blank.
He, the dignified young master of Duke Shen's residence, a sixth-grade warrior, and a leader of the younger generation in the capital, was actually slapped in public by a recognized loser?
The extreme sense of humiliation instantly overwhelmed his reason!
"What are you doing standing still!
Come on!
I want him dead!
I want his life to be worse than death! "
Shen Yufeng roared at his followers with a ferocious expression.
The group of followers seemed to be waking up from a dream, and immediately roared and rushed towards Chu Feng, their bodies full of energy and their momentum was terrifying.
However, they could not even get within three steps of Chu Feng.
A black ghost shadow flashed before everyone's eyes.
puff!
puff!
puff!
Along with the extreme cold light passing by, there was a series of dull sounds of penetration.
Puff puff puff...
